column1: # Console process environment and the sweep command acknowledgement; literal TAB, no CSV quoting.
#var f map<string,dyn> — supplied values, before defaults
#var cmd string — console or cleanup-window (logical name of the chosen sweep command)
# Environment names are $NAME. The only actual CLI flag here is --writers-stopped of the implementation-chosen sweep command.
# commands=cleanup-window is a logical invocation name for that chosen command; it does not require a new executable name.
# Ports/URLs/rings remain strings where activation and semantic validation belong to the called operation. No implicit CLI spelling is imposed on environment.
# Empty bad does not waive imported catalogue, role, ring placement, server, box, address, kit or trust checks.
# Cross-process DOMAIN_* and RELAY_* in the lifecycle are configured at their owning domain/agent process, not invented as console inputs.
